_about: Where coverage ends at the project boundary. Rule (implemented in inventory._drop_outside): roads are cut at the city limit; a bridge deck that crosses the limit is excluded ENTIRELY, so coverage ends at the last land junction before it (never mid-span). The approach stub is recorded as a 'boundary_bridge_cut' junction. The GWB is the one documented extension.
